Cricket: India's Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's potential debut against England debated

Speculation surrounds the potential debut of 15-year-old Indian cricketer Vaibhav Sooryavanshi in the T20I series against England. While some former players have backed his inclusion, team management has indicated a cautious approach, emphasizing the need for him to earn his place. England captain Harry Brook has also commented on strategies to counter the young player.
